How we decide the winner

  1. 1
    Test many ads at once

    Different styles go out side by side: UGC, podcast, animated, X-ray and talking body parts.

  2. 2
    Follow every lead to the end

    We track each ad’s leads past the form, all the way to whether they sign.

  3. 3
    Signed cases decide

    The winner is the ad with the most signed cases at the lowest cost per case, not the one with the most leads.

The psychology behind why our ads get you signed cases

Our ad in his feed
Our ideal customer

Meet John.

This is who we’re looking for.

  1. A couple of months agoHe hurt his right shoulder on the job.
  2. Right nowWorkers’ comp made him an offer. He’s not sure it covers his missed work, his bills or the surgery he might need.
  3. Tonight, 8 pmDinner, bills on the table, scrolling Instagram. That’s when he sees our ad.
The ad he sees

We speak straight to his pain point.

The right momentIt reaches him while the offer is still on his mind, in the feed he’s already scrolling.

His exact injuryAn eye-catching video that targets his exact pain point: a shoulder injury he got at work, and a lowball offer from workers’ comp.

One easy next stepFive questions, 60 seconds, to see if he may be owed more. No upfront cost, and no fee unless they win.

One offer, every injury

Same offer. A different injury, a different person.

John isn’t the only one. Every version keeps what won and speaks to one specific pain point after a work injury.
